_comment: Copy to seed.json (gitignored), then run `node core/src/trust/seed.js`. Trust is DEFAULT-DENY. Principal id `owner` is the install operator. Web chat + asmltr ask post channel assistant-web; core stamps sender.raw_id from ASMLTR_WEB_OWNER_ID (fallback X-Remote-User). Seed that same value as an assistant-web identifier. CLI is not a trust channel. Discord values below are placeholders (18 zeros / 18 ones) — replace with real numeric user ids locally; do not invent them. Do not put personal names, emails, or host paths in this example. default_tier is a schema field, not the send gate. Same-guild Discord post is trusted role or resolve() allow. Owner (bypass_moderation) always can. Stills/video/code are NOT this file — see shared/media-allow.example.json.

principals.notes: Owner / full trust. Local assistant-web only until Discord is added later.
Example friend principal. Same-guild Discord post needs a trusted/send grant, not this tier field. Not owner — no bypass_moderation. Replace id/display_name and the discord identifier before seeding.
